jobs.description:
**Type:** Full Time, Hybrid

**Team:** Research

**Focus:** AI & Agent Systems

**Who We Are**
--------------

We're a team of founders, engineers, researchers, creatives, and operators building what we believe will be one of the defining companies of the AI era.

Some of us came from startups. Some from academia. Some from hospitality, defense, design, or completely different worlds. We don’t care how you got here - we care about your energy, intelligence, curiosity, resilience, and ambition.

### **Who We Are Not**

* ***We are not remote.*** We value the spontaneous moments that happen when we’re together - over dinner, in the hallway, around whiteboards. We like being around each other because the best conversations here rarely happen in meetings.
* ***We are not your typical team.*** It’s not just the 10 countries we’re from, the languages we speak or our non-traditional backgrounds. We’re solving hard problems with people we respect - we make the most of our time together, we make it special.
* ***We are not another “polished” SF startup*****.** We value velocity over speed, raw talent over brands, and genuine human connection above all else. We value being successful, not looking successful.

**What You’ll Own & Build**
---------------------------

As a Member of Technical Staff within the Research Tribe, you’ll be one of the early engineers shaping the core systems that power Seldon.

You won’t just build agents - **you’ll design the infrastructure that governs how they operate: how they coordinate, how they’re evaluated, and how their behavior improves over time**.

This is a deeply technical role bridging distributed systems, machine intelligence, and product - turning stochastic models into reliable, production-grade systems.

* **Multi-Agent Systems Architecture:** Design and implement agentic systems, rather than prompt chains, at scale. You’ll define agent topologies, robust orchestration layers, structured state management, persistent and scoped memory, tool-use registries and execution, and build structured, inspectable systems. **You’re building a long-running harness-based agentic platform, not wiring together LLM API calls.**
* **Behavioral & Persona Modeling:** Simulate user archetypes with goal-directed behavior. You’ll design data-grounded personas, enable “computer-use” on real interfaces, and develop agents with critique and reflection loops. **You’re producing measurable, actionable behavior.**
* **Evaluation & Prompt Engineering:** Design prompt schemas and reasoning templates as integrated systems. You’ll build frameworks that measure behavioral fidelity and failure modes, and implement automated and HITL feedback. **If it can’t be measured, it doesn’t ship.**
* **Signal & Insight Systems:** Build systems that transform raw agent outputs into high-signal insights. You’ll cluster observations across runs, implement severity scoring, and map behavioral signals to product decisions. **Turn noisy outputs into decisions.**
* **Production Reliability:** Build the infrastructure to operate agents in production. You’ll implement tracing, attribution, and cost monitoring, detect failure modes and design fallbacks, circuit breakers, and evaluation pipelines. **The bar is production reliability.**

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **Systems, Not Prompts:** You prioritize state machines, orchestration layers, and tool-use contracts over prompt hacking. You build for reliability, inspectability, and improvability - you’re uncomfortable with “it just works sometimes.” **If it can’t be measured, it doesn’t ship.**
* **Production Experience:** You have 5+ years building complex software and 2+ years shipping agentic LLM systems. You’ve built harnesses where agents manage tool selection, error recovery, and multi-step execution autonomously in production environments that run, break, and evolve.
* **Orchestration Systems:** You’re experienced with multi-agent orchestration, sandboxed execution, and complex backends. You optimize for coordination, scoped memory & context, and how agents degrade gracefully under pressure.
* **Python Mastery:** You’re an expert in async programming and structured data modeling (Pydantic), building maintainable, scalable systems designed for extensibility.
* **Fast, Iterative Builder:** You thrive when research and product move together. You’re comfortable shipping quickly, learning from real users, and refining systems in tight loops.
* **High Ownership, Low Ego:** You take responsibility for what you build. You’re willing to be wrong, change your mind, and prioritize being effective over being “theoretically right.
* **Comfortable at the Frontier:** You’re excited by ambiguous problems. You’re not waiting for best practices - you’re helping define them.
* **Product Intuition:** You prioritize signal over noise because outputs matter. You care that what you build helps someone make a decision.
* **All Backgrounds Welcome: S**ome of us are dropouts, some have PhDs. Some are tech veterans, some are first-timers. What matters - how you think, how you build, and how you work in teams.

**Why Seldon**
--------------

* **The People:** Join a global team of founders, engineers, researchers, and adventurers obsessed with human behavior - we’re curious, willing to be wrong, and privileged to be solving hard problems at the frontier.
* **The Problem:** Deep science with real impact. We leverage behavioral modeling, cognitive science, and cutting-edge AI to solve real product challenges for real customers.
* **The Velocity:** Ship fast and learn faster. Work directly with customers and see the impact of your work in hours, not weeks or months.
* **The World-Class Backing:** Backed by top funds including MaC VC, Protagonist, Rackhouse, Blank, and Weekend Fund, as well as scouts at a16z, Greylock and CRV, and product leaders and researchers from orgs. inc. Meta, Airbnb, Google, Discord, Uber and more.

jobs.title: Research Scientist, CBRNE AI Safety
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Research Scientist to join our FAIR Security, Privacy, and Reliability team, focusing on Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear, and Explosives (CBRNE) safety and preparedness for AI models. In this role, you will conduct research to evaluate and mitigate potential risks associated with AI systems in CBRNE domains, develop safety frameworks, and contribute to Meta's responsible AI initiatives. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure our AI models are prepared to handle sensitive content responsibly and safely.  
  
  

### **Research Scientist, CBRNE AI Safety Responsibilities:**

* Conduct research on AI model safety in CBRNE domains, including biology, chemistry, radiological, nuclear, and explosives-related content
* Develop evaluation methodologies and benchmarks to assess AI model vulnerabilities and safety in CBRNE contexts
* Design and implement safety mitigations and guardrails for AI systems to prevent misuse in sensitive domains
* Collaborate with policy, legal, and product teams to translate safety research into actionable guidelines
* Contribute to preparedness frameworks that anticipate and address emerging risks in CBRNE-related AI applications
* Publish research findings and represent Meta at academic and industry forums on AI safety
* Partner with external researchers, government agencies, and safety organizations to advance CBRNE safety standards

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* PhD in biology, chemistry, nuclear science, security studies, or a related field, OR equivalent experience in CBRNE safety research
* 2+ years of experience in research related to biosecurity, chemical safety, nuclear safety, or weapon non-proliferation
* Experience with risk assessment methodologies and safety evaluation frameworks
* Track record of published research or contributions in CBRNE safety, AI safety, or related domains
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams on safety or policy initiatives
* Due to export control laws and regulations applicable to this role, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Knowledge of dual-use research concerns and responsible disclosure practices
* Background in red-teaming, adversarial testing, or safety evaluation of AI systems
* Experience developing safety guidelines or policies for emerging technologies
* Experience with AI/ML systems and understanding of large language model capabilities and limitations
* Experience working with government agencies or international organizations on CBRNE preparedness

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  
  
Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.

Apple's Foundation Models team is building the next generation of large language models that power intelligent experiences across Apple products. High-quality, diverse, and scalable training data is fundamental to advancing model capabilities in knowledge, reasoning, coding, and multilingual understanding.  
  
We are seeking talented and motivated Research Engineers to advance the state of the art in pretraining data research and engineering. In this role, you will develop novel algorithms and scalable systems for data curation, quality assessment, and optimization, working closely with model training researchers to translate innovative ideas into measurable improvements in foundation model capabilities.  
  
This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of cutting-edge machine learning research and large-scale systems engineering, with direct impact on the development of next-generation foundation models.  
  
**Description**

You will investigate new approaches to improving training data quality, diversity, and efficiency, while building robust and scalable infrastructure to support the processing of massive datasets. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The e-Beam division plays a critical role in KLA’s inspection ecosystem, with tools that deliver high-resolution, timely insights into defects and critical locations on the wafer. Used alongside KLA’s patterned and bare wafer inspectors, e-Beam systems help our customers quickly identify and understand yield-impacting issues—enabling faster, more effective actions to correct the manufacturing process.

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

You will develop next-generation calibration solutions that reduce calibration time, improve accuracy and repeatability, compensate for drift, strengthen tool-to-tool matching, and enable more intelligent diagnostics and recovery. * Apply machine learning, statistical modeling and physics-informed AI to predict calibration outcomes, model system behavior, and improve calibration decisions.
* Build methods to detect drift, anomalies and performance excursions using engineering, operational and fleet-level data.
